message.content: {"caption":"Eight scatterplots compare the spatial distributions of A-mem and Base memory embeddings across Dialogues 3–10.","description":"A chart of eight scatterplot panels, arranged in three rows: (a) Dialogue 3, (b) Dialogue 4, (c) Dialogue 5; (d) Dialogue 6, (e) Dialogue 7, (f) Dialogue 8; and (g) Dialogue 9, (h) Dialogue 10. Each panel has a legend identifying A-mem as blue points and Base as red points. The horizontal and vertical axes show numeric embedding coordinates with different scales across panels; neither axis has a title or stated unit. There are no connecting lines, arrows, or other marks. In every panel, the red Base points form a relatively diffuse cloud, while the blue A-mem points show more localized concentrations and subclusters, though the series overlap. The separation into visible blue clusters is especially apparent in Dialogues 4, 6, 7, and 9; the clouds are more intermixed in Dialogues 5 and 10.
